# Governance Requirements Quality Checklist: SpecKit Folder Organization Refactoring

**Purpose**: Validate that governance and procedural requirements are well-specified, complete, and unambiguous before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [SpecKit Folder Organization Refactoring & Quality Audit](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command to evaluate the quality of governance-specific requirements. It focuses on testing whether REQUIREMENTS are well-written, not whether implementation is complete.

**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the governance requirement-quality criterion is satisfied. `[x]` means the requirement is clear, complete, and implementable—not that the implementation is done.

---

## Governance Authority & Approval Gates

- [ ] CHK001 Is governance authority (@ashley) explicitly documented as the approval authority for specification changes? [Spec §Assumptions, Governance Authority]
- [ ] CHK002 Are approval gates defined for each major procedure (new spec creation, spec updates, catalog maintenance)? [Spec §FR-009, FR-010, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Can approval requirements be objectively verified (not subjective)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Is escalation procedure documented for when governance authority cannot be reached? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are approval timelines specified (how long approval should take)? [Gap]

## Numbering Scheme & Specification Identification

- [ ] CHK006 Is the numbering scheme documented as 3-digit sequential (001, 002, 003...)? [Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it explicitly stated that current specs (001-012) will NOT be renumbered? [Spec §Clarifications, §Assumptions, Numbering Scheme]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the rule for future numbering clear: next = highest + 1? [Spec §FR-012, User Story 5, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Can the numbering scheme be mechanically validated (e.g., "no gaps in current set"; "next must be max+1")? [Spec §FR-002, FR-012, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Are edge cases for numbering specified (e.g., what if spec 005 is deleted—can 005 be reused? Answer: No)? [Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the naming convention (`{NNN}-{slug}`) explicitly testable (3 digits zero-padded, lowercase slug, hyphenated)? [Spec §FR-003, SC-001]

## Maintenance Procedures & Processes

- [ ] CHK012 Are procedures for adding new specifications step-by-step? [Spec §FR-009, User Story 4, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Are procedures for updating existing specifications step-by-step? [Spec §FR-010, User Story 4, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Are procedures written in plain English suitable for non-technical governance stakeholders? [Spec §Assumptions, Process Documentation]
- [ ] CHK015 Does MAINTENANCE.md specify who can update existing specifications? [Spec §FR-010, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Are catalog maintenance procedures defined (when to update, who updates, approval required)? [Spec §FR-004, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the deprecation/archival procedure documented (how to mark specs as deprecated without deleting)? [Spec §Assumptions, Historical Specifications]
- [ ] CHK018 Can compliance with maintenance procedures be audited (e.g., checklist, automated checks)? [Spec §User Story 4, SC-009]

## Specification Quality Framework

- [ ] CHK019 Are all 8 quality dimensions explicitly named (Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Scenario Coverage, Edge Cases, Dependencies, Ambiguities)? [Spec §FR-005, FR-006, §Assumptions, Quality Framework]
- [ ] CHK020 Is each quality dimension defined with clear pass criteria? [Spec §FR-006; Data Model required]
- [ ] CHK021 Are quality gates objective and measurable (not subjective)? [Spec §SC-004, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the procedure documented for re-validating spec quality after remediation? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Can quality audit results be spot-checked against the actual spec (line references, quotes)? [Spec §FR-007, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the percentage bar for "passing" specs defined (e.g., 6/8 dimensions pass = 75%)? [Gap]

## Specification Catalog (CATALOG.md) Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Is CATALOG.md location specified as `.github/specs/CATALOG.md`? [Spec §FR-004, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Are required fields for each catalog entry specified (number, title, purpose, status, created date, link)? [Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the requirement that 100% of specs appear in catalog documented? [Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK028 Is link validity a requirement (links must point to valid spec directories)? [Spec §FR-004; Data Model: CatalogEntry validation rule]
- [ ] CHK029 Can catalog completeness be audited (e.g., "count specs in catalog vs. count directories in filesystem")? [Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the 7-day update requirement documented (catalog current within 7 days of new spec)? [Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK031 Can catalog currency be measured (e.g., compare creation date of spec vs. last-updated date in catalog)? [Spec §SC-008]

## Audit Procedures & Quality Validation

- [ ] CHK032 Is the audit scope explicitly bounded (which specs are in scope: `.github/specs/` only, not `.github/projects/active/openspec/`)? [Spec §Assumptions, Scope]
- [ ] CHK033 Are audit acceptance criteria testable (can audit pass/fail be determined objectively)? [Spec §User Story 1, 3; Acceptance Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the inventory report format specified (what fields, what order)? [Spec §FR-001, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK035 Can gaps be detected mechanically (e.g., scan filesystem, compare against sequential list)? [Spec §FR-002, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK036 Can naming convention compliance be checked mechanically (regex match on `{NNN}-{slug}`)? [Spec §FR-003, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the procedure for handling specs with missing spec.md documented (error message, remediation)? [Spec §Edge Cases, FR-001]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the audit time budget specified (must complete in <30 seconds per SC-007)? [Spec §SC-007]

## Scope & Boundaries

- [ ] CHK039 Are historical/archived specifications explicitly included (not excluded)? [Spec §Assumptions, Historical Specifications]
- [ ] CHK040 Is it clear that remediation of quality gaps is out-of-scope (this spec only identifies gaps, not fixes them)? [Spec §Assumptions, Remediation Timeline]
- [ ] CHK041 Is automation for catalog updates explicitly out-of-scope for v1? [Spec §Assumptions, Catalog Maintenance]
- [ ] CHK042 Are other spec locations (e.g., `.github/projects/`) explicitly out-of-scope? [Spec §Assumptions, Scope]
- [ ] CHK043 Is it clear that no specs will be deleted or consolidated? [Spec §Assumptions, Historical Specifications]

## Traceability & Measurability

- [ ] CHK044 Can each success criterion be measured against an implementation (testable objective metric)? [Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK045 Are percentage thresholds measurable (e.g., SC-004: "≥95% accuracy"; SC-005: "≥90% coverage"; SC-009: "100% compliance")? [Spec §SC-004, SC-005, SC-009]
- [ ] CHK046 Are time-based success criteria realistic (e.g., SC-007: "<30 seconds"; SC-008: "within 7 days")? [Spec §SC-007, SC-008]
- [ ] CHK047 Are all 12 functional requirements mapped to user stories (can we trace which FR belongs to which story)? [Spec §FR-* mapped to US1-5]
- [ ] CHK048 Are all success criteria mapped to requirements (can we trace which SC validates which FR)? [Spec §SC-*mapped to FR-*]
- [ ] CHK049 Do user stories each have independent test acceptance scenarios? [Spec §User Stories 1-5, Acceptance Scenarios]

## Assumptions & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK050 Are all assumptions documented in the Assumptions section? [Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK051 Is each assumption stated as a positive fact (not a wish or hope)? [Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK052 Are dependencies on external tools documented (e.g., `/speckit-analyze`, Unix utilities)? [Spec §References; Plan §Primary Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK053 Is the Constitution (Principle VII for quality framework) referenced? [Spec §Assumptions, Quality Framework; §References]
- [ ] CHK054 Is governance authority (@ashley) identified as a key stakeholder for approval decisions? [Spec §Assumptions, Governance Authority]

## User Story Completeness

- [ ] CHK055 Does each user story (US1-5) have clear value statement (Why this priority)?  [Spec §User Stories 1-5, "Why this priority"]
- [ ] CHK056 Does each user story have independent test acceptance criteria (can test without other stories)? [Spec §User Stories 1-5, Independent Test]
- [ ] CHK057 Do all user stories together satisfy the feature description (audit folder, create catalog, audit quality, establish maintenance, verify numbering)? [Spec §User Stories 1-5]
- [ ] CHK058 Are user stories prioritized (P1 vs P2) with clear justification? [Spec §User Stories 1-5, Priority]
- [ ] CHK059 Is acceptance testable for each user story (can verify done without reading implementation code)? [Spec §User Stories 1-5, Acceptance Scenarios]

## Clarity & Ambiguity

- [ ] CHK060 Are all vague terms quantified (e.g., "quickly" = "<30 seconds"; "high quality" = "≥95% pass on spot-check")? [Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK061 Are there any [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remaining in the spec? [Spec §Clarifications—resolved]
- [ ] CHK062 Is the term "specification" used consistently throughout (not sometimes called "spec", sometimes "requirement", sometimes "document")? [Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK063 Are procedure names consistent across REQUIREMENTS, MAINTENANCE, and CATALOG references? [Spec §FR-009, FR-010, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK064 Is technical jargon minimized (procedure docs will be read by non-technical governance stakeholders)? [Spec §Assumptions, Process Documentation]

## Edge Cases & Error Handling

- [ ] CHK065 Are all edge cases identified in the Edge Cases section? [Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK066 Can each edge case handling requirement be verified? [Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK067 Is the handling of missing spec.md files documented (should fail audit)? [Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK068 Is the handling of specification deprecation/supersession documented? [Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK069 Is the prohibition on number reuse documented (no reuse after archive)? [Spec §Edge Cases]

## Implementation Readiness

- [ ] CHK070 Are all deliverables defined (CATALOG.md, MAINTENANCE.md, audit report, remediation plan)? [Spec §Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK071 Are file paths absolute and unambiguous (e.g., `.github/specs/CATALOG.md` not `specs/CATALOG.md`)? [Spec §FR-004, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK072 Can an independent team implement this specification without asking clarification questions? [Spec §Clarifications—all resolved]
- [ ] CHK073 Is the quality checklist (this document) useful for validating requirement quality before implementation begins? [Spec §Checklist coverage]

---

## Notes

- All items are evaluated against REQUIREMENT quality, not implementation status
- Mark `[x]` only when reviewer confirms the governance requirement is clear, complete, and implementable
- Unchecked items indicate either missing requirements or ambiguities that need clarification
- Reference specific spec sections when noting issues (e.g., "Spec §FR-012" or "Spec §User Story 2")
- For items marked [Gap], consider whether this information should be added to spec.md or MAINTENANCE.md
- Items marked [Spec §...] are already addressed in the specification
- `/speckit-implement` reads this checklist state to gate task execution; do not modify checkbox markers during implementation
